argvargv-env
{
  "notes": "--session-id establishes new identity; --resume continues an existing identity and is never combined with --session-id."
}
hookhook-http
{
  "fallback": "hook-command",
  "notes": "Loopback HTTP bridge with bearer interpolation; SessionStart and Setup use the command forwarder because Claude 2.1.308 does not support HTTP for them. A print-mode process exits without awaiting StopFailure command hooks, so StopFailure must stay on HTTP."
}
transcripttranscript
{
  "notes": "Durable JSONL is authoritative for message content; hook events remain authoritative for lifecycle. Besides user/assistant/system/attachment rows, 2.1.308 records per-request bookkeeping rows (api-request, api-request-shape, api-request-blob, atis-latch, cost-state) that are not conversation messages; api-request-blob rows carry message.role user or assistant without uuid or timestamp."
}
statuslinestatusline
{
  "notes": "Claude invokes the configured statusLine command with model, cost, context-window, workspace, and prompt-cache JSON on stdin (rate limits only for subscription accounts)."
}
subagentStatusLinestatusline
{
  "nativeSetting": "subagentStatusLine",
  "inputShape": "full-task-snapshot",
  "taskFields": [

    "status",
    "description",
    "label",
    "startTime",

    "tokenSamples",
    "cwd"

  "tokenSamples": {
    "maxItems": 16,
    "timestampsIncluded": false
  },
  "nominalCallbackIntervalMs": 5000,
  "notes": "Claude invokes the configured child command with the currently visible task snapshot on stdin. Rolling tokenSamples omit timestamps, so consumers must use callback-time tokenCount for rate samples. Fields whose value is undefined are omitted from the JSON.",

hook

Trigger

Observation
matcher-required
Schema fidelity
{"payload":"structural","result":"structural","carrier":"structural","limitations":["Claude publishes prose, examples, and bundled zod schemas rather than a generated JSON Schema; undocumented optional fields may exist.","Tool-specific input constraints cover Bash, PowerShell, Write, Edit, and Read; other built-in and MCP tool inputs and every tool_response remain open.","Callback schemas retain documented control fields but do not claim every event-specific invalid-field interaction."]}

PreModelSwitchagent-to-clientunverified
Channel
hook
Transport
http
Trigger
Runs before a requested model switch (/model, a picker, /config, fast mode, SDK set_model) and can cancel it. A hook still running at its timeout (native default 30 s) blocks the switch, so registration is never a passive default.
Observation
timeout-blocks
Schema fidelity
{"payload":"structural","result":"structural","carrier":"structural","limitations":["Claude publishes prose, examples, and bundled zod schemas rather than a generated JSON Schema; undocumented optional fields may exist.","Tool-specific input constraints cover Bash, PowerShell, Write, Edit, and Read; other built-in and MCP tool inputs and every tool_response remain open.","Callback schemas retain documented control fields but do not claim every event-specific invalid-field interaction."]}

Runs before a requested model switch (/model, a picker, /config, fast mode, SDK set_model) and can cancel it. A hook still running at its timeout (native default 30 s) blocks the switch, so registration is never a passive default.
